coverage_note: Hole 04:10-06:04: only Amal's lines survive (ميحة, حططنا, 'الـ WhatsApp شو جمع إشي؟'); Medi's trip sentence (chat 05:43 re7leti mnee7a ... 5a66atna la-ashyaa2) is missing, so 04:10 is filed low. 48:35-52:22 and 1:05:21-1:08:49 are Latin-transliterated by the engine. 1:02:07-1:05:04 is an English side conversation with visitors (not lesson). echo: 'book for' (15:57) = بكرا bukra (chat 'ana 3indi maw3ed bukra'). engine wrote قطرت (06:15) = his 5tart (chose); مشربية (08:39) = mashaaree3; حافظ (12:38) = 7aafez; للرمادة (14:14) = la el-remodel; 'is a صار' (27:45) = iza saar; آدي السترة (29:48) = haadi el-fatra; 'Arab' (1:06:59) = 7arb; 'half is' (1:06:10) = 7aafez; مش شجاع (13:22/13:53) is the mitshajje3/shuja3 confusable. Skipped as S4: أدام/قدام, أرسان/عرسان, basboot/mabsut, wadfeen/waade7, dropped initial e- on شتريت. Tier-3 skipped: pantalon / jacket are the loanwords on her sheet (Ban6aloan, Jakait), pronunciation only; permit / remodel / construction / elections / cards / retired are not on her sheet. Names (Italia, إسبانيا, Ramallah, Israel, أمريكا, Adam=قدام echo) not flagged.

rows.medi_said: (Medi's line missing in transcript; chat 05:43: re7leti mnee7a kteer)
rows.chat: re7leti mnee7a kteer 3ashaan 3ammi u ana 5a66atna la-ashyaa2 mnaa7 kteer.
rows.why: Amal's lone 'ميحة' (mnee7a) inside the hole where he described his trip (re7le, feminine) looks like a gender recast, but his line is missing.

rows.medi_said: شتريت أو، أم، قـ-ق-قطرت. ... قطرت أو اشتريت. I chose and bought.
rows.amal_said: اشتريت. Or you could put an "e" in the beginning، اختارت.
rows.chat: ana e5aret u eshtarait sajjad jdaad kteer
rows.why: Engine wrote قطرت for his 5tart (I chose); Amal kept giving اشتريت then said put an e at the start: اختارت (sheet: choose | E5tar); 'you could' makes it soft.

rows.medi_said: ما يـال-- ما بيعلموا كتير ... بيعمل ... كتير.
rows.amal_said: What do you mean ما بيعمل كتير؟ ... كتير what؟ ... فما بيشتغل كتير؟
rows.why: He used 3amal (do) for 'work'; Amal asked what he meant and gave بيشتغل (sheet: i work | ana bashte8el).
rows.english: Usually my uncle doesn't work much.

rows.medi_said: this time هاديل وايت. Do you guys say this?
rows.why: He said haadi el-wa2t for 'this time' (occasion); Amal replaced it with هذي المرة and he repeated هاديل مرة.

rows.medi_said: خلصنا كتير.
rows.why: Doing verb with no object; Amal asked 'a lot of what?' and he supplied projects (engine مشربية = mashaaree3).
rows.english: We finished a lot of projects.

rows.medi_said: انبستي، انبس-- انبسط. أنا، أنا انبسط.
rows.why: Past 'I' ending -t missing; Amal prompted 'إن...', he tried انبسطت؟ and she confirmed انبسطت.
rows.english: I enjoyed myself on my trip a lot.

rows.medi_said: وحدة اليوم. One of the days. وحدة... Is it وحدة اليوم أو
rows.amal_said: No. ... Or without any ands or ons. What's one؟ ... واحد. What's of؟ ... من. What's the days؟
rows.chat: e7na mashaina fi el-6abi3a waa7ad min el-ayyam
rows.proposed_rule: 'One of the X' is waa7ad (matching the noun's gender) + min + el- + the PLURAL noun, never an idafa with a singular: waa7ad min el-ayyam.
rows.why: He built an idafa (wa7de el-yoam); Amal said No and walked him word by word to واحد من الأيام; no bucket covers 'one of + plural'.
rows.english: One of the days we walked in nature.

rows.medi_said: واحد من أيام.
rows.why: el- missing on 'the days'; Amal said الأيام and he repeated واحد من الأيام (could be read as part of row 1026-7's walk-through).

rows.medi_said: does backward turn into كلنا؟ ... كلنا؟ كلنا؟
rows.chat: akalna fi mat3am mu5talef kul yoam
rows.why: He offered كلنا (kulna, 'all of us') for 'we ate'; Amal said No, أكلنا and he took it ('that's right').
rows.english: We ate at a different restaurant.

rows.medi_said: yeah. كل اليوم.
rows.chat: akalna fi mat3am mu5talef kul yoam
rows.why: He meant every day (Amal: 'Every day?') but said kul el-yoam (all day); Amal said كل and he fixed to كل يوم.

rows.medi_said: the other word was هدف.
rows.why: Recalling the second word for motivation he said هدف (goal); Amal gave دافع (sheet: motive / motivation | Daafe3).

rows.medi_said: أنا مشتاق، مشتاق، مش شجاع.
rows.why: Engine wrote مش شجاع (shuja3, brave) — the known mitshajje3/shuja3 swap; Amal recast متشجع (sheet: motivated | Mitshajje3); may be the engine, not him.
rows.english: I'm motivated to work a lot too.

rows.medi_said: إحنا، اه، بنستعمل ... بنستعمل صديق من العيلة.
rows.amal_said: بس فـ- شو، شو قصدك بنستعمل؟ ... So تستعمل is to use. ... We're working with.
rows.why: 'Use' (esta3mal) is not said of hiring people; Amal questioned it and gave 'working with', he said بنشتغل مع.
rows.english: We're working with a family friend.

rows.medi_said: احنا نشتغل، بنشتغل مع صديق عيل- عيلة،
rows.amal_said: صديق. عائلة who? ... Or the family. ... صديق العائلة. ... Or صديق عائلتي.
rows.why: Idafa owner left bare; Amal asked 'family who? or the family' and he said صديق العيلة / صديق عيلتي.

rows.medi_said: I keep wanting to say hope, but I don't know how to say ... أنا بدي...
rows.chat: bass ana ana batmanna n5alless fi shahrain
rows.why: Didn't-know: he said he doesn't know 'hope' and Amal supplied بتمنى.
rows.english: I hope we finish in a month.

rows.medi_said: ما بنوّف...
rows.why: Answering 'will your work stop?' he used the present; Amal's 'ما want' (engine for ما راح) prompted ra7, and at 22:18 she gave ما راح نوقف شغلنا.

rows.medi_said: I don't know how to say front ... Would you guys say daher?
rows.why: Didn't-know: he asked how to say front (guessing daher) and Amal gave قدام (sheet: in front of | Quddaam).

rows.medi_said: راح نتغير. ... راح-- what? راح نت-نتغير.
rows.amal_said: راح نـ ... We will change. We will be changed.

rows.english: We're going to change the front of the store.

rows.medi_said: الـ-- أ-أدام الـ محل
rows.why: He put el- before 2uddaam; Amal: 'No الـ first', قدام المحل (she later says it's إضافة).

rows.medi_said: if we say the red house, it would be, uh, بيت، بيت الـ، آآآ، الـ أحمر.
rows.why: In a rule question he built 'the red house' with no el- on the noun; Amal recast البيت الأحمر (it was a question example, hence low).

rows.medi_said: راح نستعمل تحت الـ محل،
rows.amal_said: تحت is under. What's behind؟ أو ورا. ... ورا.
rows.why: He used تحت (under) for 'the back'; Amal said 'تحت is under' and gave ورا (sheet: behind | Wara).

rows.medi_said: أنا، أنا بحمس.
rows.why: Verb form for the state 'I am excited'; Amal said No, أنا متحمس (sheet: excited | mit7ammes); he said بحمس لـ again at 25:31 (same slip, one row).

rows.medi_said: آدي السترة. ... لا.
rows.amal_said: بتتذكر شو يعني فترة؟ ... فترة is period of time.

rows.medi_said: شوب بس أعل شوب.
rows.chat: el-jaww lissa shoab bas a2al shoab min abel.
rows.why: Comparative left without its 'than'; Amal added 'from before' and he said شوب أعل شوب من قبل.

rows.medi_said: مش بنحتاج jacket.
rows.why: mish before a verb; Amal said ما and he said ما بنحتاج jacket.

rows.medi_said: الـ، uh, قبل الـ آدي الدرس.
rows.why: haadi (fem) with masculine dars; Amal said هذا and he said هذا الدرس.

rows.medi_said: هم اللي تنين.
rows.why: He used illi where el- belongs ('the two'); Amal repeated her line (engine الذين, likely el-tnein) and he said التنين.

rows.medi_said: بيعيد هون؟ ... Eid is like holiday, right?
rows.why: He heard her إيدهم (hands) as عيد (holiday); Amal said No, إيد.

rows.medi_said: be jawaz-- be, be it jawazu.
rows.why: He said byjawwzu (marry someone off) for 'they get married'; Amal said ممتاز then recast the t- form بيتجوزوا (sheet: i get married | Ana batjawwaz).

rows.medi_said: ما كانت تجوزني.
rows.chat: 5atibti 7akatli enno heyye ma kaanat ra7 tetjawwazni abel 3ashar sneen
rows.proposed_rule: 'Would (not) have' in the past = kaan + ra7 + bare verb: ma kaanat ra7 tetjawwazni (she wouldn't have married me).
rows.why: He meant 'wouldn't have married me'; Amal recast كانت راح تتجوزني (adds ra7 and the t- form), he took it ('Oh, wait, yeah').
rows.english: She wouldn't have married me ten years ago.

rows.medi_said: هي عرفتني، اه، قبل عشر، اه، سنين.
rows.amal_said: هي كانت بتعرفك. ... She used to know you قبل عشر سنين.
rows.why: Amal recast to kaan + present ('she used to know you'), but her chat keeps his 3erfatni, so it may be a meaning check, not a fix.
rows.english: She knew me ten years ago.

rows.medi_said: دولات، دولات
rows.amal_said: No, do you wanna say one country or countries؟ ... صح معناها دول. ... دول.
rows.chat: ana kunet fi duwal mu5talefeen kul sanne.

rows.medi_said: غير دول،
rows.chat: ana kunet fi 8eir dawle kul sane

rows.medi_said: راح أزيد، um، هنين غرفة، غرفة نوم.

rows.medi_said: and what was hope again? أنا بتـ...
rows.why: Didn't-know again: he asked for 'hope' a second time (first at 19:18) and Amal gave بتمنى.

rows.amal_said: بتمنى. No. ... I asked you قبل ... you said أنا بتمنى, so it works.
rows.why: ra7 with a b- verb (and not needed); Amal said بتمنى. No — plain أنا بتمنى works.

rows.medi_said: عندي ثلاث مشاري AI لـ محل،
rows.why: Meant 'for my store'; Amal said لا and he fixed to لـ محلي, she said Yes.

rows.amal_said: Yes، بس make it feminine. ... ضريبة.
rows.why: Masculine form of the noun (sheet: tax | Dareebe); Amal said make it feminine, ضريبة.

rows.amal_said: م، fix it. ... First it has its plural.

rows.medi_said: uh, darayibni, darayibni.

rows.why: For Fall he said ربيع (spring); Amal said No, ربيع is spring, and he said خريف (sheet: autumn / fall | 5areef).

rows.why: Masculine verb for 7arb, which Amal had just stressed is feminine; she prompted (engine حربز = el-7arb?) and he said ما تخلص الحرب.

rows.why: Amal types el-kul with a singular verb (byestanna); he used plural; no voiced signal and plural is also heard in speech.

rows.medi_said: darib.
rows.why: In the word review he again gave the masculine darib for tax (fixed to ضريبة at 48:05; sheet Dareebe); Amal let it pass.
